message.content:
Based on the reference image, here is an **extremely detailed breakdown** of this portfolio website's design system:

---

## 1. OVERALL LAYOUT STRUCTURE
- **Container**: Full-width dark background with a centered max-width container (approximately 1400px)
- **Header**: Fixed/sticky top navigation bar spanning full width
- **Hero Section**: Two-column layout (60% text left, 40% image right) with decorative corner brackets
- **Content Flow**: Vertical stacking of distinct sections separated by subtle spacing
- **Grid System**: Hybrid layout using CSS Grid for cards (4-column), Flexbox for navigation and hero alignment
- **Footer**: Full-width with multi-column grid (4 columns + copyright bar)
- **Floating Elements**: Fixed social sidebar on right edge, scroll-to-top button bottom-right

---

## 2. COLOR SCHEME (Exact Hex Codes)
| Element | Color | Hex Code |
|---------|-------|----------|
| **Primary Background** | Pure Black | `#000000` / `#0a0a0a` |
| **Secondary Background** | Dark Gray (Cards) | `#111111` / `#1a1a1a` |
| **Primary Accent** | Vibrant Orange | `#ff6b00` / `#f97316` |
| **Primary Text** | White | `#ffffff` |
| **Secondary Text** | Light Gray | `#9ca3af` / `#a1a1aa` |
| **Tertiary Text** | Medium Gray | `#6b7280` |
| **Border/Subtle** | Dark Gray Lines | `#262626` / `#333333` |
| **Success/Status** | Green Dot | `#22c55e` |

---

## 3. TYPOGRAPHY SPECIFICATIONS
**Font Family**: 
- Primary: **Inter** or **SF Pro Display** (Sans-serif, geometric)
- Headings: Bold/Extrabold weight (700-800)
- Body: Regular/Medium (400-500)

**Type Scale**:
- **H1 (Name)**: 64px-72px, Weight 800, Letter-spacing -0.02em, Line-height 1.1
- **H2 (Section Titles)**: 32px-40px, Weight 700, Centered or Left-aligned
- **H3 (Card Titles)**: 18px-20px, Weight 600
- **Body Text**: 16px, Weight 400, Line-height 1.6, Color `#9ca3af`
- **Small/Caption**: 14px, Weight 500, Uppercase for labels
- **Nav Links**: 15px, Weight 500

**Text Treatment**:
- Headings: All caps for "I DESIGN. I CODE." phrase
- Orange highlighted words: "DIGITAL EXPERiences" (mixed case emphasis)
- Section labels: Orange, uppercase, 12px, letter-spacing 0.1em

---

## 4. HERO SECTION LAYOUT (Detailed Breakdown)

**Left Column (Text Content)**:
- **Top Label**: "FULL STACK DEVELOPER | DIGITAL MARKETER" (Orange, 12px, uppercase, tracking wide)
- **Main Heading**: "MUHAMMAD HASNAIN" (White, ~70px, bold)
- **Tagline Stack**: 
  - "I DESIGN. I CODE." (White, 36px)
  - "I BUILD DIGITAL EXPERiences." ("DIGITAL EXPER" in orange, rest white)
- **Bio Paragraph**: 2-3 lines, gray text (`#9ca3af`), max-width 500px, describing skills (Full Stack, AI, SEO, Google Ads)
- **CTA Buttons Row**:
  - Primary: "View My Work →" (Orange background `#ff6b00`, black text, rounded-full, padding 12px 28px)
  - Secondary: "Download CV ↓" (Transparent, border `#333`, white text, same padding)
- **Stats Row**: 4 horizontal stats with icons:
  - Clock icon + "1+ Years Experience"
  - Check circle + "20+ Projects Completed"
  - Users + "10+ Happy Clients"
  - Trophy + "5+ Technologies"
  - *Style: Flex row, gap 32px, icon orange, label gray*

**Right Column (Visual)**:
- **Main Image**: Professional photo of developer (dark hoodie), cutout style (no background)
- **Background Graphic**: Large stylized "MH" monogram in orange (`#ff6b00`) positioned behind head, opacity 80%, rotated slightly
- **Decorative Frame**: Thin orange lines forming corner brackets around the image (top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right corners only)
- **Status Badge**: Floating card bottom-right of image:
  - "Available for Freelance Projects"
  - Green pulsing dot indicator
  - Dark background `#111`, rounded-lg, shadow-lg

---

## 5. NAVIGATION SYSTEM
**Position**: Top fixed header, full width, height ~80px, backdrop-blur (glassmorphism effect)

**Structure**:
- **Left**: Logo "MH" (Orange `#ff6b00`, bold, italic/slanted font style, ~32px)
- **Center**: Horizontal menu items:
  - Home (active state: orange underline or text color)
  - About
  - Services
  - Skills
  - Projects
  - Experience
  - Education
  - Contact
  - *Style: Gap 32px, text 15px, hover effect: orange color transition*
- **Right**: "Let's Talk →" button (Outlined, rounded-full, border orange, text orange, padding 8px 24px)

**Mobile Behavior**: Hamburger menu implied (not visible in desktop view)

---

## 6. SECTIONS VISIBLE (Top to Bottom)

### **A. About Me Section**
- **Layout**: Two columns (Image left 40%, Content right 60%)
- **Left**: Photo of person at computer with code screens, dark ambient lighting, orange glow effects
  - *Overlay Badge*: Star icon + "Passionate about Clean Code & Great Design" (floating card bottom-left of image)
- **Right Content**:
  - Label: "ABOUT ME" (orange, uppercase, 12px)
  - Heading: "Building digital products with purpose and precision." (white, 32px)
  - Paragraph: Bio text (gray)
  - Button: "More About Me →" (outlined, rounded)
  - **Feature List** (right side of text): 4 items with icons in vertical stack:
    - Diamond icon: Clean & Modern Design
    - Monitor icon: Responsive & Scalable
    - Gauge icon: Performance Focused
    - User icon: User Experience Driven
    - *Style: Icon orange, text white, flex items-center gap-3*

### **B. Services I Offer**
- **Label**: "WHAT I DO" (centered, orange, uppercase)
- **Heading**: "Services I Offer" (centered, white, 40px)
- **Grid**: 4 columns (responsive to 2x2 on tablet, 1 column mobile)
- **Cards** (4 total):
  1. **UI/UX Design** - Palette icon, description text, arrow link
  2. **Front-End Development** - Code icon `</>`, tech list (HTML, CSS, JS...)
  3. **Full Stack Development** - Server/Stack icon, PHP/MySQL mention
  4. **Digital Marketing** - Megaphone icon, SEO/Google Ads focus
  - *Card Style: Dark bg `#111`, border `#222`, rounded-xl, p-6, hover:border-orange transition*

### **C. Tech Stack**
- **Label**: "MY TECH STACK" (centered, orange)
- **Heading**: "Technologies I Work With" (centered, white)
- **Layout**: Horizontal scrolling or flex-wrap row of technology icons
- **Items**: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, React, PHP, MySQL, Tailwind CSS, Flutter, Git, GitHub
- **Style**: Each icon in rounded square container (bg `#1a1a1a`, border `#333`), size ~60x60px, colorful brand logos, label below in gray text

### **D. Experience Timeline**
- **Label**: "EXPERIENCE" (left-aligned, orange)
- **Layout**: Two-column timeline (Left: Internship, Right: Freelance)
- **Timeline Visual**: Vertical line (orange) connecting nodes (circles)
- **Entry 1 (Left)**:
  - Role: Frontend Developer Intern
  - Company: Interim Intelligence
  - Date: Feb 2025 – Mar 2025 (Orange date)
  - Bullet points: 4-5 achievements (gray text)
- **Entry 2 (Right)**:
  - Role: Full Stack Developer (Freelance)
  - Date: 2025 – Present
  - Bullet points: Detailed responsibilities
- **Style**: Alternating left/right, orange dot markers on timeline line

### **E. Featured Projects**
- **Header Row**: "FEATURED PROJECTS" (left) + "View All Projects →" (right, outlined button)
- **Grid**: 4 columns (or horizontal scroll)
- **Project Cards** (4 visible):
  1. **Portfolio Website** - Screenshot thumbnail, title, desc "Personal portfolio built with HTML...", tags "HTML, CSS, PHP", "View Site →" link
  2. **HarKaam** - App screenshots, marketplace app description
  3. **AI-Powered Career Platform** - Dashboard UI preview
  4. **EduMind AI** - Learning platform interface
  - *Card Style: Rounded-xl overflow-hidden, bg `#111`, image top (aspect 16:9), content padding, hover:scale or border-orange*

### **F. Information Grid (Bottom Section)**
**4 Columns Layout**:

1. **Certifications**:
   - List with bullet points (custom orange bullets):
     - Full Stack React E-Commerce (Greatstack)
     - AI-Powered Digital Advertising (Google)
     - AI-Powered Marketer (SEMrush)
     - Generative AI Essentials (Microsoft)

2. **Education**:
   - Timeline style vertical list:
     - Diploma Software Engineering (Aug 2025)
     - Business Administration (Aug 2025)
     - Pre-Engineering (Aug 2022)
   - *Connected by thin orange line*

3. **Additional Information**:
   - Icon + Label pairs:
     - Languages: English, Urdu
     - Location: Karachi, Pakistan
     - Availability: For Freelance Work
     - Interests: AI, Web Development...

4. **Contact Form** ("LET'S WORK TOGETHER"):
   - Heading: "Have a project in mind? Let's create something amazing."
   - Form Fields:
     - Your Name (input, bg `#111`, border `#333`, rounded)
     - Your Email (input)
     - Your Subject (input)
     - Your Message (textarea, taller)
   - Submit Button: "Send Message ✈️" (Full width, orange bg, black text, rounded)

### **G. Footer**
- **Top Bar**: Logo "MH" (left) + Copyright "© 2025 Muhammad Hasnain..." (center/left)
- **Navigation**: Repeated nav links (Home, About, Services... Contact) centered or right-aligned
- **Background**: Black, border-top `#222`
- **Scroll Top**: Circular button bottom-right (bg `#111`, arrow up icon, fixed position)

---

## 7. CARDS/CONTAINERS SPECIFICATIONS
- **Shape**: `border-radius: 12px` to `16px` (rounded-xl/2xl)
- **Background**: `#111111` (slightly lighter than pure black)
- **Border**: `1px solid #262626` (subtle dark gray)
- **Shadow**: `0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.3)` on hover or specific cards
- **Padding**: `24px` standard, `32px` for larger cards
- **Hover Effects**: 
  - Border color transitions to `#ff6b00` (orange)
  - Subtle transform `translateY(-4px)`
  - Box-shadow increase

---

## 8. BUTTONS STYLES
**Primary Buttons** (Filled):
- Background: `#ff6b00` (Orange)
- Text: `#000000` (Black)
- Padding: `12px 28px`
- Border-radius: `9999px` (Pill shape)
- Font-weight: 600
- Hover: Brightness 110% or slight scale

**Secondary Buttons** (Outlined):
- Background: Transparent
- Border: `1px solid #404040` or `#ff6b00`
- Text: White or Orange
- Same pill shape
- Hover: Background rgba(255,107,0,0.1)

**Icon Buttons**:
- Social icons in floating sidebar: Circle bg `#111`, icon white/orange, 40x40px size
- Arrow buttons: Inline with text, animated on hover (translateX movement)

---

## 9. ICONS & GRAPHICS
**Icon Set**: 
- **Style**: Phosphor Icons or Heroicons (outline style), stroke width 1.5-2
- **Color**: Orange `#ff6b00` for active/accent, `#9ca3af` for secondary
- **Specific Icons Used**:
  - Navigation: GitHub, LinkedIn, Mail, Globe, Refresh/History (sidebar)
  - Stats: Clock, CheckCircle, Users, Trophy
  - Services: Palette (design), CodeBracket (dev), ServerStack (backend), Megaphone (marketing)
  - Features: Diamond, Monitor, Gauge, UserCircle
  - Tech: Brand logos (HTML5, CSS3, JS, React, etc.)
  - UI: ArrowRight, ArrowUp, Download, Star, MapPin, Calendar, Mail, Send

**Graphic Elements**:
- Large "MH" watermark behind hero image (vector, orange, low opacity)
- Corner bracket decorations (L-shaped lines, 2px stroke, orange)
- Gradient mesh/ambient glow behind hero (subtle orange radial gradient at 20% opacity)
- Code screenshot overlays in project images

---

## 10. SPACING & ALIGNMENT
**Spacing Scale** (8px base unit):
- Section padding: `80px 0` (vertical), `100px` for hero
- Container padding: `0 24px` (mobile), `0 48px` (desktop)
- Card gaps: `24px` (grid gap)
- Element margins: `16px` between related items, `32px` between groups
- Text margins: Paragraphs `margin-bottom: 16px`

**Alignment Rules**:
- Headings: Centered for sections (Services, Tech), Left for content blocks
- Body text: Left-aligned, max-width constrained for readability (~65ch)
- Navigation: Space-between (logo left, links center, CTA right)
- Cards: Stretch to fill grid, content left-aligned inside
- Footer: Distributed space-between

**Layout Density**:
- Spacious whitespace (generous padding)
- High contrast zones (dark cards on darker background via borders)
- Breathing room around typography (line-height 1.6 for body)

---

## 11. SPECIAL EFFECTS & ANIMATIONS
**Visible Effects**:
1. **Glassmorphism Header**: `backdrop-filter: blur(12px)` with `background: rgba(0,0,0,0.8)`
2. **Gradient Overlays**: Subtle orange radial gradient behind hero image (`radial-gradient(circle at 70% 30%, rgba(255,107,0,0.15), transparent)`)
3. **Glow Effects**: Orange box-shadow on buttons/icons on hover (`0 0 20px rgba(255,107,0,0.3)`)
4. **Image Treatments**: 
   - Slight desaturation on photos (contrast boost)
   - Orange tint/color overlay on hero photo edges
5. **Status Indicator**: Pulsing animation on green "available" dot (`@keyframes pulse`)
6. **Border Animations**: Hover states where border-color transitions from `#333` to `#ff6b00` over 0.3s ease

**Implied Animations** (standard for this design type):
- Scroll-triggered fade-in for sections (Intersection Observer)
- Counter animation for statistics (1+, 20+, etc.)
- Smooth scroll behavior
- Button hover lift effect (`transform: translateY(-2px)`)

---

## 12. UNIQUE DESIGN DETAILS
1. **Monogram Integration**: The large "MH" behind the portrait creates personal branding depth
2. **Corner Brackets**: Technical/blueprint aesthetic framing the hero image suggests precision/engineering
3. **Mixed Case Emphasis**: "DIGITAL EXPERiences" breaks the word visually to draw attention
4. **Dual Timeline**: Experience section uses a zig-zag timeline (alternating sides) rather than standard left-align
5. **Status Badge**: Floating "Available" badge with real-time feel (green dot) adds urgency/trust
6. **Icon Consistency**: All service and feature icons use consistent stroke width and orange coloring
7. **Form Integration**: Contact form embedded in main flow rather than separate page, reducing friction
8. **Tech Logo Treatment**: Technology icons have consistent container styling (rounded squares with dark backgrounds)
9. **Sidebar Socials**: Fixed right-edge social icons provide persistent access without cluttering header
10. **Color Psychology**: Heavy use of orange (`#ff6b00`) against black creates high energy, creativity, and technical warmth—uncommon compared to typical blue/purple dev portfolios

---

## IMPLEMENTATION NOTES FOR DEVELOPMENT:

**CSS Architecture**:
- Use CSS Custom Properties for the color palette (`--color-primary: #ff6b00`, etc.)
- Implement a `container` class with `max-width: 1280px` and `mx-auto`
- Use `display: grid` with `grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr)` for services/projects
- Mobile-first approach with breakpoints at `768px` (tablet) and `1024px` (desktop)

**Key Components to Build**:
1. `HeroSection` (flex row, image with absolute positioned decorations)
2. `ServiceCard` (reusable with icon slot, title, description, link)
3. `TimelineItem` (conditional class for left/right positioning)
4. `ProjectCard` (image overlay, content slide-up on hover)
5. `TechBadge` (icon container with tooltip/label)
6. `FloatingSocials` (fixed position, flex col, z-50)
7. `GlassHeader` (backdrop-blur, sticky top-0)

**Responsive Considerations**:
- Hero stacks vertically on mobile (image above or below text)
- Service grid becomes 2-col then 1-col
- Timeline becomes single column (all items left-aligned)
- Project grid becomes horizontal scroll (snap-x) on mobile
- Contact form becomes full-width

This design follows a **"Dark Mode Premium Portfolio"** aesthetic popular in 2024-2025 web trends, emphasizing technical capability through dark themes with vibrant orange accents suggesting energy and innovation.
